_comment: Seeds the Work/Part coverage model and enables citation on the six TrackType.Canon tracks (Source Material References / Canon References across Character, Bond, Organization, World Law, Civilizational System, Technology — ids confirmed live against TLTT v2.storyplan). NOT the full ~221-episode MLP:FiM catalog: 'parts' below covers only episodes/chapters already evidenced verbatim in Brian's own note text, plus season premieres/finales whose SxxExx numbering is unambiguous public fact. Where a specific episode number was NOT confidently known, 'code' is the episode title itself (no invented SxxExx) — flag, never guess, per CLAUDE.md. Extend this file (idempotent re-run) or use the in-app '+ Add new' quick-add as coverage grows.

sourceMaterials.name: MLP:FiM
sourceMaterials.description: My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic — the canon series TLTT is built on top of.

parts.name: Secret of my Excess
parts.description: Season confirmed directly in Brian's note; episode number not.

parts.name: The Crystalling
parts.description: Brian's notes use both 'The Crystaling' and 'The Chrysalling' as spelling variants for this Part.

parts.name: Sweet and Smoky
parts.description: Season confirmed directly in Brian's note; episode number not.

sourceMaterials.name: Equestria at War
sourceMaterials.description: The HoI4 mod TLTT recontextualizes — a bleaker, HoI4-mechanics version of the MLP world. Brian's own framing: the Part for EaW is a playable-country playthrough, not an episode.

sourceMaterials.name: The Princess and the Kaiser
sourceMaterials.description: The fanfic TLTT is explicitly framed as a 'fork' of — see the per-character divergence sweep in the Canon-track notes.

sourceMaterials.name: Pax Chrysalia
sourceMaterials.description: Brazen Gauge's fanfic adaptation, cited alongside EaW's own focus tree for the Love Harvester / Love Tax mechanic.

sourceMaterials.name: Hearts of Iron IV
sourceMaterials.description: The base game Equestria at War mods — cited for its own mechanics (supply hubs, tech-rush behavior) independent of the mod's pony reskin.
